text:
Denver Barkey was the 95th pick in 2023, stands 5-foot-10, and on Saturday in Columbus he scored twice, including the winner, in what Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports noted was the first time all season the Flyers had won a game that was tied at any point in the third period. "Barkey continues to impress" was how O'Connor summed it up, and the numbers agree.

He has 10 points in 19 games, five on the power play, while playing under 15 minutes a night. More telling: the Flyers take 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice and about 41% without him, a 14-point swing that's among the best on the roster. Evolving-Hockey liked his defense as a rookie too, with opponents getting fewer chances while he was out there (91st percentile).

The caveat is the shooting. Four goals on 19 shots won't last, and a hard shot is not his thing (NHL Edge has his top speed in the 9th percentile). He's a playmaker who wins his shifts, on a team that badly needs more of those.
